After a typical period, we welcome your comments, and we are sorry to hear that your trip with Aurelia Skyways left you dealing with avoidable stress around your animal's care and baggage handling. You said the crate was delayed and the cabin conditions for your pet were not handled with the care you expected.

From a safety review angle, this points to a service gap that should have been caught sooner. Our team expects the welcome staff, ramp handoff, and cabin checks to line up cleanly, and when one part slips, the whole journey can feel shaky. We have logged the issue in the desk record and asked the senior coordinator to review the chain of custody, the communication trail, and the handoff notes so the weak point can be found.

<<FACT F118>> The usual claim route still applies, and our desk can help you assemble the documents the file needs without dragging this out. If the crate issue also involved handling damage, our staff will separate that from any cabin concern so the review stays clear and fair.

<<FACT F111>> On the cabin side, the safety team will look at the temperature checks, the loading notes, and any report from the welcome team or flight crew. If the cabin felt too warm for your pet, that should be treated as a serious matter, not brushed aside. We will also make sure the record shows what was observed, what was reported, and what corrective step was taken.

We know that a companion animal is not cargo in the casual sense, and the standard here must be calm, respectful, and consistent. Please keep your reference material handy, and our desk will keep the file moving with direct communication and plain updates. Aurelia Skyways takes this seriously, and we are tightening the review so the next traveler sees better control from start to finish.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
